subject: MAP stage slip: synchronization request and risk log
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martin <elena@greenside.io>, GreenSide Procurement <procurement@greenside.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: MAP stage slip: synchronization request and risk log

Elena / Procurement team —

Quick note to flag that the MAP for the pilot evaluation is seeing a two-week slip on the integration & security gating steps. Primary drivers: (1) GreenSide’s internal SSO testing uncovered a token mapping edge case, (2) procurement requested an extra review cycle of our DPA and indemnity clause, and (3) the scheduled Kornia integration demo didn’t occur yesterday.

Attached: risk_log_20261229.csv (current scoring) — short summary below:
- Integration blockers (score 8/10): SSO token map + schema mismatch; SE team estimates 4 business days to patch + 1 day of customer verification.
- Contract pace (score 6/10): procurement review and legal redline turnaround expected 7–10 days without escalation.
- Eval window risk (score 7/10): delayed environment access reduces viable test cycles by ~40%.

Requested immediate next steps:
1) Can we agree to rebaseline the MAP milestones to: dev fix (2027-01-04), customer verification (2027-01-06), environment unlock (2027-01-07), smoke eval (2027-01-10)?
2) Can Procurement confirm if a condensed redline path (legal acceptance before final signature) is possible to avoid full review loop?
3) I’m proposing a 30-minute alignment call tomorrow 09:00 PT to confirm updated handoffs and identify where exec intervention would help (credits / onboarding priority).

Ben — can you confirm technical ETA for the patch and whether we can produce a temporary workaround for token mapping to run the smoke tests?

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Sales (West)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: risk_log_20261229.csv
From: Elena Martin <elena@greenside.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenSide Procurement <procurement@greenside.io>
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP stage slip: synchronization request and risk log

Markus —

Thanks for the heads up and the clear breakdown. We're seeing the same on our side: our SSO vendor requires the token exchange to meet our audit schema, otherwise our security team will block any environment provisioning. Procurement is also already on the thread; they requested the additional indemnity language given our data residency constraints.

Two asks from GreenSide:
- If you can provide a temporary token transform shim that we can deploy to our staging org, we can run the smoke tests while your team finishes the patch.
- Procurement: can you outline the minimum acceptable expedited review steps? We can authorize a limited-scope sign-off for the pilot if legal confirms.

We can make 09:00 PT tomorrow for alignment.

— Elena
Head of Product Ops
GreenSide Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Elena Martin <elena@greenside.io>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP stage slip: synchronization request and risk log

Elena / Markus —

We can deliver a shim for token transformation into GreenSide's staging by EOD 2027-01-04 if we prioritize it. Outline:
- Today (12/29): scope and small spike to confirm schema (done by SE pair).
- 01/03–01/04: develop & test shim; container image + deployment steps.
- 01/05: hand the image to GreenSide for verification.

I attached an updated MAP (MAP_v2_GreenSide.xlsx) with suggested milestone shifts and a short mitigation column per milestone. Key changes:
• Move environment unlock to 2027-01-07 (gives us two days buffer post-verification).
• Add a parallel track for legal acceptance (limited scope) to avoid waiting for full redline closure.
• Add an acceptance checklist for smoke tests (to protect your eval quality).

If Procurement can accept the limited-scope sign-off, we can run the smoke evals on 01/10 as Markus proposed.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_v2_GreenSide.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Elena Martin <elena@greenside.io>, GreenSide Procurement <procurement@greenside.io>
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 07:22:00 -0800
Subject: Escalation: GreenSide MAP slip — request for prioritization and conditional concessions

Jonas —

Looping you in because the slip is now likely to affect our Q1 new-logo commitment if we don’t move quickly. Summary for exec consideration:
- Impact: potential push of go-live beyond Q1 which affects forecast and QBR targets; project revenue ~$420k ARR.
- Proposed executive levers: one-time $12k pilot credit to cover extended onboarding hours; priority allocation of a solutions SE for two weeks; expedited legal review via legal ops escalation.
- Trade-offs: credits need executive approval and must be tied to a 90-day closure SLA once pilot passes smoke tests.

Please confirm whether you can approve the proposed concessions (credit + SE prioritization) so we can present an explicit remediation package to GreenSide at tomorrow’s alignment call.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Elena Martin <elena@greenside.io>
Date: Thu, 31 Dec 2026 11:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Escalation: GreenSide MAP slip — request for prioritization and conditional concessions

Laura / team —

Approved conditionally: offer the $12k pilot credit and allocate a solutions SE (Ben will lead). Conditions:
1) GreenSide formally agrees to the condensed legal acceptance for pilot only (we'll put acceptance terms into the credit_note DocuSign).
2) Updated MAP milestones and the risk log must be shared before we start work (I need visibility for GTM impact).
3) The credit is recoverable if the pilot is not converted to a paid contract within 90 days of pilot completion.

Markus — please get me the edited risk_log_20261229.csv and the signed condensed acceptance note; I will authorize legal ops to prioritize the redline.

Jonas Weber
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 03 Jan 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP stage slip: synchronization request and risk log — alignment call confirmed

Team —

Thanks all — confirming the alignment call for 2026-12-30 09:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Per Jonas' conditions, attached are: (1) updated risk_log_20261229.csv with mitigation owner and revised scores, (2) the draft condensed acceptance note (credit_request_note.pdf) for GreenSide to sign, and (3) MAP_v2_GreenSide.xlsx.

Immediate next actions:
- GreenSide: please sign the condensed acceptance note (or indicate edits) so Legal Ops can begin prioritized review.
- Ben: proceed with the shim spike and target delivery 01/04.
- Laura/Jonas: will you confirm formal approval for the credit once Legal Ops confirms the acceptance note language?

If we get agreement today, target smoke eval remains 01/10 and go/no-go decision on conversion by 90 days post-pilot.

Cheers,
Markus
Director, Sales (West)
Redwood Inference
